subject: Request: Expanded Trial Allowance for retrieval/realtime POC
messages:
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@orbitanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Trial request: retrieval/realtime POC (context + TPM)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Orbit Analytics is ready to run a short POC to validate real-time retrieval over very large contexts. High-level ask: we need an expanded trial allocation because our evaluation will do long-context retrievals (~120k token windows), sustained burst loads (peaks around 6k TPM), and heavy embedding + rerank cycles. That combination will exhaust the default PLG allowance within hours.

Success criteria:
- End-to-end latency under 1s median for retrieval-only flows
- Stable throughput at peak (6k TPM) for at least 48h of testing
- Comparable output quality to our baseline model (we will provide eval prompts)

Can you provide a one-time trial top-up and extend the trial window? I've attached our POC requirements. We'll need the ability to pin model variants and a minor SLA note for the window.

Thanks — I can be reached at +1 (415) 555-0198 if you want to sync.

—Kate Reynolds
VP Product, Orbit Analytics
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial request: retrieval/realtime POC (context + TPM)

Hi Kate — great to hear you're ready to run this.

We can absolutely support large-context and higher-TPM POCs, but this is the kind of request that needs an approval for an exception to the standard self-serve allocation. I've forwarded your POC doc to our sales ops and finance for review and will request an extended trial window.

A couple quick clarifying Qs for the POC:
- Can you confirm the expected daily token volume (rough ballpark)?
- Which models/endpoints will you exercise (text-gen only, embeddings, or both)?
- Any strict blackout windows we should avoid for maintenance?

I'll loop back with a proposed top-up and timeframe by EOD.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orbit Analytics POC — request expanded allowance

Marissa / Ben / Marcus — forwarding Orbit's POC brief (attached).

Summary: Orbit wants to run a retrieval/realtime POC with 120k-token contexts and peak ~6k TPM. Their eval will hit embeddings, reranking, and generation endpoints; estimated daily volume ~1.8M tokens/day during peak days. They request: an expanded credit grant (one-time) and an extended trial window (we typically do 14 days but they want ~45).

My recommendation: grant a 75k USD-equivalent token top-up (promo credit) and a 60-day trial window, but restrict to a curated set of model variants and enable monitoring/tracing with a webhook to our Console so we can kill if abuse spikes.

Estimated cost to Redwood at p50: ~$2.8k for the POC runway (mostly embedding + long-context gen). Risk: moderate (higher token burn). Controls: token cap, model whitelist, SLA-exception form signed.

Attachments:
- Orbit-POC-Requirements.pdf
- SLA-Exception-Request.pdf

Can you weigh in? I need an approval to issue the promo and extend trial.

Thanks,
Jasmine
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orbit Analytics POC — request expanded allowance

+1 to supporting this given the strategic fit. Suggest issuing a one-time credit code for $75,000 USD equivalent and setting a hard token cap tied to that code. Please include the SLA-Exception-Request signed by the customer before activation — we should keep legal in the loop but this is within standard one-off promo approvals.

Operational asks:
- Create promo_code: ORBIT-PROC-75K (limited-use)
- Expiry on the code: 60 days from activation
- Model whitelist: rdx-large-quant, rdx-embed-v2 (no open exploratory models)

Marcus — can you confirm finance OK with $75k promo gel? If yes we'll proceed.

Ben

Hi Kate / Sam — great news: we've approved a one-time promotional top-up to support your retrieval/realtime POC. Details below.

Grant summary:
- Promo code: ORBIT-PROC-75K
- Value: $75,000 USD (one-time credit)
- Activation window: code valid for 60 days from issuance; code will be activated when you sign the SLA exception (attached) and confirm the HubSpot deal RDW-3421 link.

2) Confirm which HubSpot contact you want associated with the grant (we have you as Kate Reynolds).
3) We'll issue the code and provide activation instructions + a short onboarding call to configure monitoring/webhooks.

Related links:

Thanks and excited to move forward — we'll keep a close eye on usage and loop in engineering if any infra constraints appear.

Best,
